name: minicrm
//engines: DECLARATIVE, not enforced. npm honours engines only under engine-strict, and no .npmrc sets it — deliberately: 82 packages in the tree declare node >= 22 and would turn every npm ci into a hard failure. CI pins the real floor via .nvmrc + setup-node. (MINCRM-704)
//packageManager: Also declarative — nothing here enables Corepack. Records the npm that ships with the node version .nvmrc pins (node:24-alpine -> npm 11.17.0), which is what CI actually runs. (MINCRM-704)

scripts.unit_test: npm test --workspace=minicrm-server && npm test --workspace=minicrm-client && npm test --workspace=minicrm-coverage-dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=minicrm-server && npm run typecheck --workspace=minicrm-client && npm run typecheck --workspace=minicrm-qa && npm run typecheck --workspace=minicrm-coverage-dashboard && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run format:check

//overrides: adm-zip is pinned to 0.6.0 under onnxruntime-node as the exact floor that clears GHSA-xcpc-8h2w-3j85 (high, <0.6.0) while accepting GHSA-vwc7-r8mq-g2x9 (moderate, >=0.5.9 <=0.6.0). 0.6.0 is the newest published version, so the moderate has no fix and this is the best available. Do not drop the pin to "resolve" the moderate — npm then resolves lower and the high returns via onnxruntime-node -> @huggingface/transformers -> promptfoo. (MINCRM-746)
//overrides.undici: Knowingly violates @connectrpc/connect-node's ^5.28.4; npm ls marks it invalid. Safe only because its sole undici use is a globalThis.Headers polyfill gated on node major < 18, dead at this repo's Node 24 floor — recheck if connect-node starts using undici for real. Held on 7.x because promptfoo declares >=7.28.0 <8, a range 8.x would break. See docs/dev/dependencies.md. (MINCRM-746)
